# CBZ Reader

> CBZ Reader (cbzreader.mavi.help) opens .cbz comic archives directly in the browser and converts CBZ to PDF. Archives are unpacked and rendered on your own device — nothing is uploaded, no account required.

## Pages

- [Home (EN)](https://cbzreader.mavi.help/): open a CBZ file, right-to-left manga reading, bookmarks, local reading progress, CBZ → PDF.
- [中文首页](https://cbzreader.mavi.help/zh/)
- [日本語ホーム](https://cbzreader.mavi.help/ja/)
- [How to open a CBZ file](https://cbzreader.mavi.help/how-to-open-cbz/)
- [What is a CBZ file](https://cbzreader.mavi.help/what-is-a-cbz-file/)
- [How to make a CBZ file](https://cbzreader.mavi.help/how-to-make-a-cbz-file/)
- [CBZ vs CBR](https://cbzreader.mavi.help/cbz-vs-cbr/)
- [CBZ file won't open](https://cbzreader.mavi.help/cbz-file-wont-open/)
- [Convert CBZ to PDF](https://cbzreader.mavi.help/cbz-to-pdf/)
- [Private processing explained](https://cbzreader.mavi.help/private-process/)
- [Privacy](https://cbzreader.mavi.help/privacy/)
- [Terms](https://cbzreader.mavi.help/terms/)
- [Disclaimer](https://cbzreader.mavi.help/disclaimer/)
- [About CBZ Reader](https://cbzreader.mavi.help/about/)

## Part of

- mavi.help (site owner): https://mavi.help/

- Sibling tool 热力地图工坊 (Excel → China heatmap): https://heatmap.mavi.help/

## Notes

- Everything runs locally in the browser: no upload, no account, no cloud copy.
- The tool is free to use.
